region.why: a deployment fact: HCAZERRS ASSIGNs SYSID into the message it writes; the corpus names no region

notes: The example-health-apis medication-add front end HCMABA01, LINKed with a COMMAREA: after the length checks it LINKs HCMADB01 (which inserts the MEDICATION row and returns its id) and, when that returned CA-RETURN-CODE 0, LINKs HCMADB02 (which inserts the PRESCRIPTION rows), then RETURNs. Tables come from the estate's @DB2CRE.jcl (HCZMSA1). scenarios.name: add-medication-and-prescription
scenarios.why: front end LINKs HCMADB01 (MEDICATION row, id returned in CA-PRESCRIPTION-ID) then HCMADB02 (PRESCRIPTION row for that id): '00'

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE (LINK HCAZERRS) then ABEND HCCA

scenarios.name: short-commarea
scenarios.why: one byte under the 18-byte header: '98', RETURN before either LINK

scenarios.name: unknown-patient
scenarios.why: HCMADB01's INSERT fails (foreign key): it returns '90', the front end RETURNs without LINKing HCMADB02
